messages:
mira: FYI onboarding cynosure6b-int6 (int6) — canary is hitting OOMs on steady traffic. Defaults: max_new_tokens=256, batching=max_batch_tokens 8192. Repro on 2 different nodes. fragmentation jumps to ~0.83 before crash. any quick ideas?

kevin: saw similar earlier with another int6 model. grabbed a short mem profile:
```
GPU0: total 24576MB used 13892MB peak 14230MB
alloc fail 2023-11-04T14:22:11Z OOM at token_index=241
mem_frag_ratio=0.83
active_alloc_pages=4523 free_pages=924
```
looks like many small allocations during KV prefetch + quant kernel temp buffers.

alina: quick mitigation: lower max_new_tokens to 128 and tighten batch size. also try enabling slot compactor runoff and disable aggressive prefetch for int6. my suggested CLI for canary:
```
redwood canary deploy --model cynosure6b-int6 \
  --max_new_tokens 128 \
  --batching.max_batch_tokens 4096 \
  --batching.max_batch_size 8 \
  --runtime.kv.prefetch false \
  --runtime.slot_compactor.threshold 0.6
```
This reduces peak working set and gives the slot compactor room to coalesce freed pages.

mira: @alina thanks — launching that now on canary 3. Will run perf/eval sweep against our prompt set.

sam: ran a quick microbenchmark on canary after the changes (1000 warm+2000 measured requests):
- before (default): p50=72ms, p95=215ms, avg GPU mem=13.8GB, OOM rate=0.9%
- after (max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=8, prefetch=false): p50=88ms, p95=150ms, avg GPU mem=11.2GB, OOM rate=0.0%
Quality eval (150 prompts) shows negligible regression: bleu delta -0.6% (within noise).

kevin: nice. also confirm that turning off prefetch moved some allocs from transient large contiguous buffers to smaller, more fragmented ones but overall freed sooner so compactor works. we should consider a short-term kernel tweak to limit per-request temp scratch to 256MB for int6 kernels. I'll open an RFC.

infra-bot: canary deployment v0.4.2 for cynosure6b-int6 started on 3 hosts — success on 2/3, rolling to remaining host. Logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/3220001234

mira: plan: keep canary live for 4h, run full evaluation suite, if regressions <= 2% and no OOMs we'll promote and set defaults to max_new_tokens=128 for int6 builds. I'll add a follow-up with the results. If anyone sees a spike, ping @kevin and @alina. :thumbsup:

kevin: opening GH issue to track kernel scratch cap + postmortem: GH#4581

alina: also adding a perf test that toggles slot_compactor.threshold in CI for quantized models so we catch regressions earlier.

mira: thanks team — saved the rollout. I'll archive logs under /ml/onboard/cynosure6b/int6/3220001234 and post summary in the onboarding doc.
